items.title: How to Build Your Own Always-On AI Agent (TypeScript)
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「Agent Skill、Harness、工具调用和自动化研发」。原文摘要显示：Build an always-on AI agent with the OpenRouter Agent SDK that runs on a schedule, remembers what it has seen, and costs under a tenth of a cent per check.
items.insightText: 重点看任务拆分、工具编排、验证闭环和可复用工程抽象，判断能否迁移到 Auto-Research / Agent Coding 链路。

items.title: We’ve received our first response from the Project Suncatcher prototype satellite.
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「AI 技术演进和可复用工程实践」。原文摘要显示：This week, we reached our "Hello World" milestone: the first-ever AI response from a data center class TPU in orbit.
items.insightText: 先快速判断它是否包含可复用方法、架构或工程经验，再决定是否进入日报深读。
